name: Turban
_about: a turban: a long cloth of linen or muslin wound round the head over the brow and the tops of the ears -- the Arab imama (white, or the Abbasids' black), the Ottoman sarik, great and white, wound round a tall red cap (wear the `fez` with it, its crown standing out of the top: the kavuk). `size`: how far it stands off the skull (cranium radii)
